pokedexEntries.go: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

pokedexEntries.si: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

pokedexEntries.cr: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

pokedexEntries.ru: KINGDRA lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this POKéMON creates spiraling ocean currents.

pokedexEntries.sa: KINGDRA sleeps on the seafloor where it is otherwise devoid of life. When a storm arrives, the POKéMON is said to awaken and wander about in search of prey.
